title: Russian Ballistic Missiles and Drones Kill 2, Injure 8 in Kyiv as Zelenskyy Meets US Lawmakers at UN
detail: Russia launched 282 attack drones and ballistic missiles at Kyiv overnight into September 24, in three separate waves. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 227 aerial targets, including roughly 60% of the ballistic missiles fired, according to President Zelenskyy. Strikes and falling debris hit the Solomianskyi, Sviatoshynskyi, Podilskyi and Dniprovskyi districts. Drone debris fell in a parking lot near Kyiv City Maternity Hospital No. 2 in the Podil district, setting cars ablaze, killing one person, and damaging the hospital's windows and facade along with a nearby clinical diagnostic center; the historic St. Pokrovsky Church (built 1906) was also damaged. The Dukachi jewelry production facility was destroyed. At least 2 people were killed and 8 injured. The attack came as Zelenskyy met with members of the US Congress on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

media.caption: Emergency crews respond after a Russian ballistic missile and drone attack struck Kyiv overnight, damaging a maternity hospital and a historic 1906 church, Sept. 24, 2026
